type: model
status: draft
builds-on: root

It also contains a valid absolute link: [evaluation loop again](features/engine/models/01-evaluation-loop.md) — this should NOT fire any rule.

evals.expected_output: Exactly one S3 finding written to ALIGNMENT-DEBT.md, targeting features/engine/models/_test-fixture-s3.md, citing the relative-link reason. After fixture deletion, second lint run adds zero new entries for the fixture path.
assertions: An ALIGNMENT-DEBT.md entry is written for _test-fixture-s3.md with rule S3
No ALIGNMENT-DEBT.md entry is written citing the valid absolute path (features/engine/models/01-evaluation-loop.md)
